query: 供应商行为准则 供应商行为准则 衡量企业要求其供应商在劳工权益、人权保障、环境保护及商业道德（如反腐败、反洗钱）等方面遵循的正式规范。重点考察条款的完整性、对违约行为的处置机制以及对准则内容的培训沟通。 一、内容质量得分 (权重 50%，取值：0, 1, 2) • 2分（卓越）：准则内容完全对齐国际基准（如 RBA, ILO）；具备阶梯式的违约惩戒与终止合作机制；设立了针对供应商的常态化合规培训计划；且准则包含“向下穿透”要求（要求其供应商也签署类似协议）。 • 1分（合格）：有正式的供应商行为准则或包含在通用采购条款中，涵盖了基础的合规、廉洁与劳工要求，但缺乏具体的违约处理流程、定期的培训赋能或深度的人权/环境保护细节。 • 0分（不合格）：无相关供应商行为准则披露，或仅有笼统的“要求供应商诚信合规”表述。 二、覆盖应用得分 (权重 50%，取值：0, 1, 2) • 2分（高覆盖）：已签署并执行准则的供应商数量或采购总额占比 >80%，并披露了对高风险供应商的强制签署情况。 • 1分（部分覆盖）：占比 >0% - 80%，或仅核心一级供应商签署而忽略了次级或长尾供应商，或未说明具体签署/覆盖比例。 • 0分（无覆盖）：无相关覆盖范围信息。 供应商行为准则 供应商标准 违约终止 阶梯式惩戒 供应商合规培训 向下穿透 次级供应商 供应商签署 高风险供应商强制签署 采购额覆盖率 RBA ILO supplier code of conduct supplier standards RBA ILO standards breach escalation termination supplier compliance training cascading requirements flow-down requirements sub-tier suppliers supplier acknowledgement mandatory signing for high-risk suppliers 是否有正式供应商行为准则？ 是否覆盖劳工、人权、环境、反腐败等条款？ 违约惩戒与终止合作机制是什么？ 是否对供应商开展合规培训？ 是否要求向下穿透，签署覆盖多少采购额/供应商？
instruction: Assess whether the passage provides concrete evidence for the ESG indicator '供应商行为准则'. Prefer explicit, auditable disclosure that answers: 是否有正式供应商行为准则？ 是否覆盖劳工、人权、环境、反腐败等条款？ 违约惩戒与终止合作机制是什么？ 是否对供应商开展合规培训？ 是否要求向下穿透，签署覆盖多少采购额/供应商？ Exclude or down-rank: 排除：仅有笼统“要求诚信合规”；仅有供应商环境标准而无劳工/道德；仅有廉洁协议单点；仅有员工行为准则；区分：供应商行为准则是综合规范；供应商环境标准、反腐败管理是其中专题深化；申诉机制是渠道；道德采购偏采购策略与冲突矿产等议题。 Preserve relevant tables, notes, units, limitations, policies, targets, methods and coverage details.

results.section: GREEN OPERATIONS / 綠色營運
results.text: In the procurement process, the Group attaches great importance to the negative environmental impact of products and the environmental performance of our suppliers. Therefore, we are committed to implementing a green procurement strategy and offering the priority for considering the application of suppliers with ISO 14001 certification. The Group clearly sets out its requirements in the contracts. Suppliers must undertake and ensure that their production, sales, transportation and after-sales activities are in compliance with national environmental and occupational health and safety management requirements. Supplier assessment and project review are conducted on a semi-annual basis to review suppliers' commitment to environmental protection and their employment of environmentally friendly equipment and measures. Meanwhile, we strengthen our communication with suppliers and actively convey the Group's advocacy and support for green procurement.

results.section: 供應商遴選制度 / Supplier Selection System
results.text: The Group has strict requirements on suppliers and supply chain management. We have developed and implemented supply chain management systems, and require employees and the management team to follow. This is to ensure that all potential suppliers can compete fairly and enjoy equal opportunities. When selecting a new supplier, the Group would review the supplier's business license and qualification according to the process, and would select at least three potential suppliers for quotation; after that, relevant departments within the Group such as the Procurement Department and the Engineering Department would assess the product quality, production scale, supply capacity and other basic information as well as testing the trial products of the suppliers based on the technology, design and quality requirements in order to ensure the stability of the supply chain.

[Content]
The Group has strict requirements on suppliers and supply chain management. We have developed and implemented supply chain management systems, and require employees and the management team to follow. This is to ensure that all potential suppliers can compete fairly and enjoy equal opportunities. When selecting a new supplier, the Group would review the supplier's business license and qualification according to the process, and would select at least three potential suppliers for quotation; after that, relevant departments within the Group such as the Procurement Department and the Engineering Department would assess the product quality, production scale, supply capacity and other basic information as well as testing the trial products of the suppliers based on the technology, design and quality requirements in order to ensure the stability of the supply chain.
